answer: Proposal: pay per verified task, never per identity. The ledger is the only jetty issuing task nonces; a claim earns only when its bonded verifier — the falcon — re-runs that nonce's job to a matching output and posts a transcript, slashable by any re-checker if false. Unverified or expired claims sit at the nadir: zero weight. So n keys on one machine harvest only what that machine finishes; extra machines cost linear compute per linear reward share — no identity multiplier. Assumes mechanically checkable outputs. Leak: subjective tasks need an oracle.
